name: mr-studio-multisession
description: A coding agent has worked across many sessions on the MR Studio web app and accumulated durable memories. Each task is a fresh session: the agent is about to do something and needs the relevant prior memories pulled into context. `relevant_ids` is the human-labeled gold set of memories that actually matter for that task.

memories.text: The MR Studio web app is a React + Vite frontend with an Express backend, written in TypeScript. Run the dev server with `npm run dev` from the project root; it listens on port 5002.
The database is PostgreSQL accessed through the Drizzle ORM. The schema lives in shared/schema.ts and migrations are managed with drizzle-kit.
Bookings are stored in UTC in the database and converted to the Asia/Tbilisi timezone only in the UI layer. Never persist local time.
The customer chatbot uses Google Gemini (gemini-2.0-flash-exp). Its system prompt and the list of services and prices live in server/gemini-chat.ts.
Known bug: the booking confirmation email sometimes sends twice because the email handler is not idempotent. Dedupe by tracking sent emails per booking id before retrying.
Authentication uses signed session cookies via express-session. Admin routes are guarded by the requireAdmin middleware in server/auth.ts.
Uploaded images go to object storage; the ACL logic is in server/objectAcl.ts. Public read is allowed only for files under the gallery/ prefix; everything else stays private.
Gemini occasionally returns an empty response. server/gemini-chat.ts must fall back to a default message instead of throwing, otherwise the chat widget crashes.
Frontend styling uses Tailwind with custom CSS tokens defined in client/src/index.css. Do not hardcode hex colors inside components.
Currently implementing multilingual support for the chatbot (Georgian 'ka' and English 'en'); the language is passed from the client and selects which system prompt is used.
Next step: add rate limiting to the public chat endpoint /api/chat to prevent abuse of the Gemini API key. No limiter exists yet.
Replaced the old hardcoded services list on the landing page with data fetched from the /api/services endpoint.
Email notifications are sent through the helper in server/email-notifications.ts using the studio's SMTP credentials from environment variables.
Calendar sync writes confirmed bookings to Google Calendar via server/google-calendar.ts using a service account; a sync failure must not block the booking from being saved.

tasks.query: Fix the bug where customers receive two confirmation emails for a single booking.
Add rate limiting to the chat endpoint so the Gemini API key cannot be abused.
A booking shows the wrong time to the customer. Investigate how timezones are handled for bookings.
Update the list of services and prices the chatbot tells customers about.
Make the gallery images publicly viewable while keeping all other uploads private.
Add a new admin-only settings page and make sure it is protected like the other admin routes.
The chat widget sometimes crashes when Gemini replies. Make the chat resilient to bad responses.
